verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a comprehensive Admin REST API, OIDC/SAML protocol endpoints (introspection, revocation, dynamic client registration, device grant), and a CLI (kcadm.sh) that mirrors the REST API, giving programmatic/API-driven control over realms, users, clients, and policies. Community feedback (keycloak-comm-13) notes some API inconsistency for idempotent automation, a real but secondary caveat. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s) and independent hands-on validation of the API's completeness.
